summary.business_type: Service Area Business — web agency (Veendam, Groningen; serving Noord-Nederland + NL)
top_findings: No case studies, portfolio, testimonials or quantified results anywhere on the site — confirmed live across 14 pages; the single largest E-E-A-T and conversion gap for a web agency
Mobile cookie-consent banner is broken sitewide — missing -translate-x-1/2 pushes accept/reject buttons off-screen on every page, on every mobile session (VIS-1)
Organization/LocalBusiness schema has no street address, KvK or BTW number anywhere — legally required in NL and the cheapest available local-trust signal
LCP is Poor-to-Needs-Improvement under lab stress test on all 4 sampled pages (3.4-4.4s), driven by main-thread JS contention (Framer Motion + Radix), not the already-optimized hero image
Zero reviews and only one external profile link (Google Maps) — Local SEO scores 44/100 on the weighted rubric, driven almost entirely by off-site signals
quick_wins: Fix the cookie-banner CSS bug (add -translate-x-1/2) — one CSS class, fixes a defect visible on 100% of mobile sessions
Fill ADDRESS.streetAddress, postalCode, KVK and VAT_ID in src/lib/seo.ts — footer and schema already read from these constants and will render automatically

Add brand name ("AIMI") back into FAQ answers and /wordpress-of-maatwerk body copy — 22/25 FAQ answers and the whole comparison page currently say "we/wij" only, weakening AI-citation attribution (GEO-6)
Swap the shared GENERIC_EXAMPLES portfolio image out of ExampleSlideshow — one component change fixes the same irrelevant stock image appearing on all 13 vertical + 15 city pages (SXO-5 / VIS-2)
Consolidate the duplicate Cache-Control header and set server_tokens off in nginx — 10 minutes, closes two Low findings
summary.note: Volledige live audit uitgevoerd 2026-09-06 door 11 gespecialiseerde subagents (technical, content, schema, sitemap, performance, visual, geo, local, sxo, backlinks, drift), bovenop de bestaande 2026-09-04 baseline. Technical/Schema/Content/Performance/Local/GEO scores hieronder zijn live herverifieerd; On-Page en Images scores zijn ongewijzigd overgenomen uit 2026-09-04 (niet dit keer opnieuw gecrawld). Zie findings/ voor volledige bewijsvoering per categorie.

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: robots.txt exemplary and live-verified (2026-09-06): AI crawlers (GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, PerplexityBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, Googlebot, Bingbot) explicitly allowed; scrapers (Bytespider, PetalBot, MJ12bot) blocked; /portal, /admin, /account, /server, /api/, /track.js disallowed; sitemap declared
Sitemap validated via sitemap_discovery.py: found through robots.txt declaration, HTTP 200, valid urlset, all 48 URLs present
Canonicals self-referencing and correct on all sampled pages (home, tarieven, 2 vertical, 2 city pages)
Redirects clean: http→https 301, www→apex 301, trailing-slash→no-slash 301, max 2 hops on combined http+www case, true 404 (not soft-404) on unknown URLs
Compression now fixed — Content-Encoding: gzip confirmed live on JS, CSS and woff2 (previously Critical finding TECH-1, verified resolved 2026-09-06)
Caching now fixed — fonts and hero images now return Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable (previously High finding TECH-2, verified resolved 2026-09-06)
IndexNow key file now live — /b03bb73bce86422c6a74b3cfc829f2dd.txt returns 200 with correct key content (previously High finding TECH-3, verified resolved 2026-09-06; route added in commit d38d9ab)
Strong security headers: CSP with object-src 'none'/base-uri 'self'/frame-ancestors 'self', HSTS 1yr+includeSubDomains, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy

Structured data is rich and page-type-aware: Organization/ProfessionalService + WebSite sitewide, FAQPage + BreadcrumbList on content pages, LocalBusiness on city pages, Service on vertical pages, OfferCatalog/Offer with pricing on /tarieven
SSR content parity confirmed: raw HTTP fetch (no JS) returns full page text (is_spa: false via render_page.py) — content is fully crawlable by non-JS clients and AI answer engines

Programmatic city/vertical pages are adequately differentiated (~30-35% text similarity between same-type pages, rest unique), word counts ~1,100-1,250 — no thin/duplicate content risk detected in sample
Mobile viewport correct (width=device-width, initial-scale=1, zoom not disabled); single variable font file with font-display: swap avoids extra font requests/FOIT
LCP hero image uses responsive srcset/webp, fetchPriority=high, preload, and explicit width/height attributes (CLS-safe)
llms.txt present and well-curated (agent-UX bonus, not a core scoring category)

findings.title: Static assets served completely uncompressed
findings.description: No Content-Encoding on any /assets/*.js or *.css. Main bundle 881,681 B served vs 248,487 B at gzip -9. The homepage ships ~1.2 MB of JS/CSS where ~330 KB would do. HTML is gzipped; files nginx serves from disk are not. VERIFIED 2026-09-06: curl now shows Content-Encoding: gzip on /assets/index-*.js, styles-*.css and the woff2 font. Issue resolved.
findings.recommendation: Add gzip_types covering application/javascript, text/css, image/svg+xml and font/woff2 to the nginx static location. Add brotli if ngx_brotli is available.

findings.title: Fonts and images have no Cache-Control
findings.description: /fonts/*.woff2 (27 KB, preloaded) and /assets/hero-forest-*.webp (74 KB, the LCP element) return no Cache-Control and no Expires, while sibling .js/.css files correctly get max-age=31536000, immutable. VERIFIED 2026-09-06: font and hero webp now return Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable. Issue resolved.
findings.recommendation: Extend the nginx location regex to cover woff2, webp, png, jpg, svg and avif.

findings.title: IndexNow key file returns 404
findings.description: /b03bb73bce86422c6a74b3cfc829f2dd.txt is 404. INDEXNOW_KEY is defined in src/lib/seo.ts and scripts/indexnow-submit.mjs exists, but the verification route is uncommitted and undeployed, so every submission is rejected. VERIFIED 2026-09-06: https://aimi-development.nl/b03bb73bce86422c6a74b3cfc829f2dd.txt now returns 200 with body 'b03bb73bce86422c6a74b3cfc829f2dd'. Issue resolved. Note: only key verification was checked live; whether scripts/indexnow-submit.mjs is actually invoked on publish (CI/cron) was not verified in this pass.
findings.recommendation: Commit and deploy the key route, then verify the URL serves the key as plain text.

findings.title: Duplicate Cache-Control headers
findings.description: Static assets return Cache-Control twice (max-age=31536000 and public, immutable) — an nginx expires directive and an add_header both firing. Some proxies handle duplicates inconsistently. STILL PRESENT 2026-09-06: confirmed via curl -D- on /assets/index-*.js and styles-*.css — two Cache-Control lines are still emitted (max-age=31536000 then public, immutable).
findings.recommendation: Consolidate into a single add_header directive.

findings.title: Sitemap lastmod is stale
findings.description: PARTIALLY IMPROVED 2026-09-06: lastmod dates are no longer a single stale value — sitemap.xml now shows 5 distinct dates (2026-08-20 x7, 2026-08-21 x20, 2026-08-22 x7, 2026-09-03 x1, 2026-09-04 x13), but the large identical clusters (20 URLs sharing one date, 13 sharing another) still look like batch/deploy timestamps rather than genuine per-page content-change tracking.
findings.recommendation: Derive lastmod from actual content/CMS modification timestamps, or omit the field if that data isn't reliably tracked.

findings.title: CSP allows 'unsafe-inline' for script-src and style-src
findings.description: Live CSP header: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data: https://*.supabase.co; connect-src 'self' https://*.supabase.co https://calendly.com; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://assets.calendly.com; frame-src 'self' https://calendly.com; font-src 'self'; frame-ancestors 'self'; base-uri 'self'; object-src 'none'. 'unsafe-inline' on script-src and style-src neutralizes CSP's main defense against injected/XSS script and style execution — any inline script that gets injected (e.g. via a compromised dependency or reflected input) would still execute.
findings.recommendation: Move inline styles/scripts to external files or adopt a nonce/hash-based CSP (nonce-{random} per response, generated in server.ts) so 'unsafe-inline' can be dropped from both directives.

findings.title: Homepage eagerly modulepreloads ~21 JS chunks, including non-critical ones
findings.description: Homepage <head> contains 21 <link rel="modulepreload"> tags fired at high priority alongside the LCP image and font, including chunks not needed for first paint: Contact-B2LhGYg3.js, Footer-BB8uYLHM.js, contact.functions-Df-PP1OP.js, auth-middleware-BxmmoFAN.js, calendar-5Yl3ivCd.js, mail-DyXXUlUJ.js, send-CjJ7l3aR.js. Combined gzip size of the core chunks alone (index+radix+utils+motion+index2) is ~325 KB gzip / ~950 KB uncompressed. This front-loads network contention on the critical path and adds hydration/parse work that can push out LCP and increase INP on mid/low-end mobile, particularly since is_spa is false but the page still fully hydrates client-side.
findings.recommendation: Restrict modulepreload to chunks required for first paint/interaction; lazy-load or route-split Contact/Footer/calendar/mail/auth-middleware chunks so they load on interaction or viewport-entry instead of eagerly on every page load. Re-measure with Lighthouse/PSI once API credentials are available.

findings.title: Security headers duplicated on HTML responses (two layers both setting them)
findings.description: curl -D- on https://aimi-development.nl/ shows X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy and Strict-Transport-Security each emitted twice — once lowercase, once Title-Case, with identical values (e.g. 'x-frame-options: SAMEORIGIN' and 'X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN'). CSP and Permissions-Policy are NOT duplicated, indicating nginx re-adds a legacy subset of headers already set by the Node/TanStack Start app. Not currently harmful since values match, but it's config drift risk — if the two layers are edited independently in future they could silently diverge.
findings.recommendation: Set these 4 headers in exactly one layer (either server.ts or nginx, not both) to remove duplication and the drift risk.

findings.title: Server header discloses exact nginx version
findings.description: Server: nginx/1.28.3 (Ubuntu) is sent on every response, disclosing the exact web server version and OS distribution.
findings.recommendation: Set server_tokens off; in nginx.conf to suppress version disclosure.

categories.name: Content Quality
categories.note: Rescored 2026-09-06 after live re-verification via render_page.py (extracted_text), superseding the 2026-09-04 score of 78. Word-count and E-E-A-T figures below come from live rendered pages, not source code. See findings/content.md for full method, sample list (14/48 pages), and explicit list of what was not re-checked this pass.
what_works: FAQPage JSON-LD confirmed live and valid on homepage (25 Q&As) and on the kapsalon vertical page (7 Q&As, including industry-specific price and duration answers)
Branch-specific pricing (€499 Starter / €749 Pro) and “hoe lang duurt” answers now present on all 6 vertical pages sampled — confirms the 2026-08-24 code-audit gap (C-2/C-3) has been fixed

Vertical pages (kapsalon vs. hovenier, direct text diff) contain genuinely different, industry-specific substance, not find-and-replace text — duplicate-content risk assessed as low on the 12 programmatic pages sampled
Strong pricing/policy transparency sitewide: explicit € amounts, “geen lock-in”, source-code ownership stated, one-month cancellation term, security stack listed (SSL, daily backups, 24/7 monitoring)
Organization/ProfessionalService schema includes Person entities for the two named founders — present on sampled pages

findings.title: No case studies, portfolio, testimonials, or quantified results anywhere sampled
findings.description: Live-checked homepage, /over-ons, and 12 programmatic pages: zero client names, zero before/after examples, zero “X websites delivered” style numbers, zero review/rating content. /over-ons names the two founders and states principles but shows no evidence of past delivered work. Confirms the 2026-08-24 code-audit finding is still true live, not stale.
findings.recommendation: Add at minimum 2-3 real case examples (client name with permission, what was built, one concrete outcome number) before further programmatic page expansion — this is a prerequisite for Experience/Authoritativeness to improve.

findings.title: No KvK/BTW/postal address confirmed on sampled pages
findings.description: Not re-verified live on /contact in this pass (out of the 14 pages sampled this run). Carried over from the 2026-09-04 findings file, which reported 0 hits for KvK/BTW across all 48 pages. Treat as unconfirmed-but-likely-still-true pending direct re-check.
findings.recommendation: Verify live on /contact and sitewide footer; if still absent, add KvK number, BTW/VAT ID and postal/visiting address.

findings.title: Vertical/service pages measure 646-760 words live, below the 800-word service-page floor
findings.description: All 6 sampled vertical pages (kapsalon, nagelstudio, hovenier, makelaar, autobedrijf, boekhouder) measured 646-760 words of extracted main content. Not a ranking factor by itself, but combined with the lack of case evidence and identical template skeleton across 13 pages, topical depth per page is on the thin side.
findings.recommendation: Expand the “Veelvoorkomende knelpunten” section per page with one concrete, industry-specific example; verify the remaining 7 unsampled vertical pages match this range.

findings.title: Identical template skeleton repeats across all sampled vertical/city pages
findings.description: Direct text comparison (kapsalon vs. hovenier) shows identical section order/headings with genuinely different substance per section — not a duplicate-content violation, but a formulaic pattern visible across 13 near-identical page skeletons.
findings.recommendation: Vary section order or add one vertical-specific section type (e.g. image gallery for visually-driven trades vs. compliance/document section for boekhouder) to break the pattern.

findings.title: /over-ons thin for its trust-building role
findings.description: 223 words live. Names founders and states 4 principles but has no case evidence, no team-photo reference in text, no years-in-business claim, no numbers.
findings.recommendation: Expand with founder background and, once available, the case-study evidence from the case-studies finding above.

findings.title: Word-count figures in this category conflict with the 2026-09-04 version of this file by roughly 2x
findings.description: Previous Content Quality entry reported city/branch page averages of 1,051/1,177 words; this live pass measured 562-760 words on overlapping page types using trafilatura extracted_text (which strips nav/footer/related-links chrome by design). The Technical SEO category in this same file also reports ~1,100-1,250 words for the same page types, suggesting the higher numbers may include page chrome rather than main content.
findings.recommendation: Reconcile methodology across categories before reporting word-count trends: re-run both a raw-HTML-text count and an extracted_text count on 2-3 identical URLs to identify the source of the ~500-word gap.

findings.title: ✅ Branch-specific pricing and duration long-tail gap (prior audit C-2/C-3) fixed
findings.description: Confirmed live on 6/13 vertical pages: branch-specific price ranges and “hoe lang duurt” FAQ answers are present and correctly structured as distinct FAQPage Q&As.
findings.recommendation: Spot-check the remaining 7 vertical pages for consistency; no action needed on the 6 sampled.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Canonical, single h1, lang=nl, viewport, og:image, og:title, og:type and twitter:card all 48/48
Zero duplicate or missing titles and descriptions
No accidental noindex anywhere
All primary content present in server-rendered HTML

findings.title: ✅ Four titles exceed the SERP display limit
findings.description: /seo is 70 chars, / is 64, /tarieven 63, /website-laten-vernieuwen 61. Google truncates around 60, and /tarieven risks losing its EUR 499 price hook.
findings.recommendation: Trim each to 60 characters or fewer, keeping the strongest click driver in front.

findings.title: ✅ Two pages missing og:url
findings.description: /privacybeleid and /algemene-voorwaarden are the only pages without og:url.
findings.recommendation: Add og:url to both for consistency.

findings.title: ✅ Six descriptions slightly under target
findings.description: 112-117 characters where 120-160 is useful: /website-laten-maken-assen, /branches, /website-laten-maken-autorijschool, /website-laten-maken-klusbedrijf, /website-laten-maken-schilder and /website-laten-maken-roden.
findings.recommendation: Extend each to roughly 150 characters.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Live-verified 2026-09-06 across 10 sampled URLs (/, /tarieven, /website-laten-maken, /webshop-laten-maken, /faq, /website-laten-maken-kapsalon, /website-laten-maken-groningen, /webdesign, /over-ons, /contact): every JSON-LD block parses without error, uses https://schema.org context, and avoids deprecated types (no HowTo, no SpecialAnnouncement)
Stable @id entities (/#organization, /#website) are byte-for-byte identical across all 10 sampled pages — confirmed live, no duplicate/conflicting entity graphs
Homepage's 25-question FAQ IS emitted as FAQPage schema (8,829 bytes, 25 Question/Answer pairs) — an older static-audit hypothesis that this was missing is now confirmed stale

/contact now carries a dedicated ContactPage + ContactPoint (telephone, email, availableLanguage nl, contactType customer service) correctly nested under the shared Organization @id — previously flagged gap is confirmed fixed live

Kapsalon's Service block is produced by the same shared serviceJsonLd() helper as every other Service block, with areaServed intentionally set to null via a documented parameter for branch pages — an older hypothesis that it was an inconsistent inline one-off is confirmed false
Veendam LocalBusiness correctly uses parentOrganization to link back to /#organization
priceValidUntil computed dynamically (2027-09-06) rather than hardcoded

findings.title: ProfessionalService/Organization has no address, geo or opening hours anywhere
findings.description: The shared /#organization entity (identical on all 10 sampled pages) declares telephone, email, priceRange (€€), sameAs, knowsAbout, areaServed and hasOfferCatalog, but no address, geo or openingHoursSpecification. The only PostalAddress on the site (Veendam LocalBusiness) has addressLocality/addressRegion/addressCountry but no streetAddress or postalCode — confirmed live, matches src/lib/seo.ts where ADDRESS.streetAddress and postalCode are deliberately left empty.
findings.recommendation: Fill in the real street address and postcode in the ADDRESS constant in src/lib/seo.ts — postalAddress() already auto-includes it in both the organization entity and the Veendam LocalBusiness the moment those two fields are non-empty, no schema code changes needed. Add openingHoursSpecification once hours are confirmed.

findings.title: Only one sameAs reference
findings.description: sameAs contains a single Google Maps short link on every sampled page. No LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram or KvK register URL to cross-corroborate the entity.
findings.recommendation: Add profile URLs as they become available.

findings.title: No aggregateRating or Review markup
findings.description: No review markup on any of the 10 sampled pages, consistent with the absence of collected reviews on-site.
findings.recommendation: Collect real reviews first, then mark them up. Do not mark up ratings without genuine reviews behind them.

findings.title: Identical FAQPage schema duplicated verbatim on / and /faq
findings.description: The homepage's FAQPage block and the /faq page's FAQPage block are both exactly 8,829 bytes with the same 25 Question/Answer pairs, byte-identical. No mainEntityOfPage or distinct @id on either block to indicate which URL is authoritative for that content.
findings.recommendation: Not a Google ranking risk (FAQ rich results are retired for all sites), but redundant. Either trim the homepage's FAQ to a curated subset (as already done on vertical/city pages, which each carry a distinct 6-8 question set) and keep the full 25 only on /faq, or add mainEntityOfPage to disambiguate.

findings.title: Homepage FAQPage carries 25 questions
findings.description: Valid schema, all 25 questions verified live to mirror visible on-page content. Google retired FAQ rich results for ALL sites as of 2026-05-07 (superseding the 2023 gov/health-only restriction), so there is no SERP benefit; any AI/GEO citation benefit is unconfirmed.
findings.recommendation: No action required for Google SERP purposes. Optional: consolidate with the /faq duplication finding above.

findings.title: /over-ons has no WebPage/AboutPage entity
findings.description: /over-ons carries only the site-wide Organization, WebSite and BreadcrumbList blocks. The codebase already defines a webPageJsonLd() helper (src/lib/seo.ts) with about/isPartOf/dateModified, but it was not observed on any of the 10 sampled live pages.
findings.recommendation: Apply the existing webPageJsonLd() helper to /over-ons (and confirm whether it is intended to run sitewide) — no new schema design work needed, the helper already exists.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: 46 ms median TTFB, 275 ms worst case
LCP image preloaded with a responsive imageSrcSet (640/960/1280 WebP)
Font self-hosted and preloaded with crossorigin
max-age=31536000, immutable on hashed JS/CSS
Zero render-blocking third-party scripts

findings.title: No compression on any static asset
findings.description: The main bundle ships 881 KB instead of 248 KB; total JS/CSS is roughly 1.2 MB instead of ~330 KB. This is the highest-impact fix on the site, is server config only, and carries no regression risk.
findings.recommendation: Enable gzip (and brotli) for JS/CSS MIME types in nginx.

findings.title: 881 KB main bundle is oversized even compressed
findings.description: At 248 KB gzipped it remains large for a marketing site. Radix UI (54 KB raw) and motion (127 KB raw) are significant contributors, and Radix is largely needed by the authenticated portal and admin rather than public pages.
findings.recommendation: Split portal/admin code out of the bundle that public marketing routes load. Do this after compression is enabled.

findings.title: 21 modulepreload-hints op de homepage (afgezwakt)
findings.description: Oorspronkelijk High. Correctie: index.tsx rendert echt <Contact />, dus die chunks horen bij de afhankelijkheden van de pagina. Wat overblijft: formuliercode onder de vouw laadt met dezelfde prioriteit als content erboven. Na compressie is het totaal ~330 KB.
findings.recommendation: Bewust niet aangepast: lazy laden zou het formulier uit de SSR-HTML halen, wat slechter is voor SEO dan de winst waard is.

findings.title: LCP image and font uncached
findings.description: The hero WebP (74 KB, the LCP element) and the preloaded font (27 KB) carry no Cache-Control, so repeat visitors pay for both again.
findings.recommendation: Add immutable cache headers for webp and woff2.

findings.title: Homepage HTML is 109 KB
findings.description: More than twice the 42 KB site average, largely from 25 inline FAQ entries in JSON-LD plus 12.7 KB of inline scripts.
findings.recommendation: Trim the homepage FAQ schema to the most valuable entries.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: /llms.txt present, 75 lines, correct format with real per-URL detail — above the standard of most implementations
AI crawlers explicitly allowed: GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, PerplexityBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended
All content in server-rendered HTML — no AI crawler needs to execute JavaScript
249 unique Q&A pairs in FAQPage schema, the most citable format there is
Clean entity graph with stable @ids

findings.title: ✅ No outbound citations
findings.description: Zero external links site-wide. Generative engines preferentially cite sources that are themselves well-connected and verifiable.
findings.recommendation: Add honest citations to authoritative sources from the pages where they are natural.

findings.title: Person-entiteiten voor de oprichters zijn te dun
findings.description: Correctie: founder-entiteiten voor Aidan en Milan bestaan al in het Organization-schema. Wat ontbreekt is kleiner: geen @id, geen jobTitle, geen sameAs.
findings.recommendation: Add Person schema linked to the organization via founder/employee.

findings.title: No date signals on any content
findings.description: No datePublished or dateModified anywhere, and only one Article. AI systems weight recency when choosing between competing sources.
findings.recommendation: Add dateModified to substantive pages.

findings.title: sameAs too thin to corroborate the entity
findings.description: One Google Maps link. Cross-platform corroboration is how an engine gains confidence that an entity is real.
findings.recommendation: Expand sameAs — see the schema category.

findings.title: Answers not front-loaded on service pages
findings.description: City and branch pages open with brand framing before the substantive answer. Passage-level retrieval favours self-contained answers that appear early.
findings.recommendation: Lead each section with the direct answer, then elaborate.

categories.name: Images
what_works: 0 of 33 images missing alt text
0 of 33 images missing width/height — consistent CLS prevention
WebP throughout, with a 640/960/1280 responsive srcset on the hero
LCP image preloaded with a matching imageSrcSet

findings.title: Hero WebP and font are uncached
findings.description: The LCP image returns no Cache-Control, so it is re-fetched on repeat visits.
findings.recommendation: Covered by the nginx cache-header fix.

findings.title: og-image.png is a 112 KB PNG
findings.description: It is fetched by every crawler and link unfurler that touches a shared URL.
findings.recommendation: Convert to WebP or optimise the PNG.

categories.name: Local SEO
what_works: 15 city pages averaging 1,051 words with only 7.7% heading overlap — not doorway pages
Honest SAB modelling: only Veendam claims PostalAddress + GeoCoordinates; other cities use areaServed
NAP single-sourced in code via PHONE_DISPLAY / PHONE_E164, so visible links and schema cannot drift apart
ACTIVE_SINCE_YEAR used as a genuine trust signal rather than an invented founding date

findings.title: No postal address published on-page
findings.description: The Veendam address exists only inside JSON-LD on one page — not on /contact, not in the footer. Google cross-checks on-page NAP against GBP and citations.
findings.recommendation: Publish the full address in the footer and on /contact.

findings.title: No KvK / BTW number
findings.description: Beyond the legal requirement, the KvK number is a primary local-citation key used by directories to match a business to the register.
findings.recommendation: Add both to the footer.

findings.title: No reviews
findings.description: No review content and no aggregateRating. Review count and velocity are among the strongest map-pack ranking factors, and a Google Maps profile already exists.
findings.recommendation: Build a systematic review request into project handover.

findings.title: Single sameAs, no citation footprint
findings.description: One Google Maps link and no evidence of Dutch directory listings.
findings.recommendation: Build foundational citations: KvK register, LinkedIn, regional directories.

findings.title: No opening hours
findings.description: Neither openingHoursSpecification in schema nor visible hours on /contact.
findings.recommendation: Add both.

categories.name: Search Experience (SXO)
what_works: Page type matches intent across the board — no mismatches found
Prices published publicly on 18 of 48 pages, winning high-intent cost queries
/website-checker is a genuine lead magnet matching real intent
Branch pages framed around the reader problem rather than the agency service list

findings.title: No proof of work for a visual buying decision
findings.description: No portfolio, case study or before/after, and testimonial language on one page. A company selling websites describes quality at length but never shows it.
findings.recommendation: Build a case-study section — the highest-leverage conversion fix on the site.

findings.title: Ook interessant blocks are undifferentiated
findings.description: Every city and branch page ends with the same related-links pattern, which reads as navigation rather than recommendation.
findings.recommendation: Use these blocks for genuine contextual linking that also builds hierarchy.

findings.title: Trust signals absent at the decision point
findings.description: /contact carries no address, KvK, hours or post-submission clarity — at the moment intent is highest.
findings.recommendation: Add trust details to /contact.

findings.title: Founders under-used as differentiator
findings.description: The strongest line on the site — direct access to Aidan or Milan — appears on 6 of 48 pages and none of the 30 acquisition pages.
findings.recommendation: Surface it on the programmatic templates.

commoncrawl.note: aimi-development.nl not found in Common Crawl host graph (cc-main-2026-jan-feb-mar) — too new/small to be sampled, not a negative score.

findings.title: No link-earning asset exists
findings.description: Every one of the 48 URLs is a commercial service page. There is no blog, research, tool writeup, or dataset — nothing whose natural purpose is to be cited. /website-checker is the closest thing to a linkable asset.
findings.recommendation: Build a small linkable asset (e.g. a genuinely useful tool or article series) tied to existing service pages.

findings.title: Zero outbound links
findings.description: The site links out to nothing across all 48 pages (see Content Quality CQ-4). Linking out is part of how a site enters a topical neighbourhood and becomes citable in turn.
findings.recommendation: Add honest outbound citations where relevant (already recommended under Content Quality).

findings.title: Thin external footprint
findings.description: Only one sameAs (Google Maps) and no discoverable directory presence found. No KvK register listing, LinkedIn company page, or regional business directory links identified.
findings.recommendation: Establish foundational citations: KvK register, Google Business Profile (exists), LinkedIn company page, regional business directories.

findings.title: Domain not present in Common Crawl host graph
findings.description: commoncrawl_graph.py returned in_crawl: false and in_rankings: false for aimi-development.nl — no PageRank or harmonic centrality data exists. Expected for a young/small site; not itself a red flag, but it means no free automated authority estimate is currently possible.
findings.recommendation: No action needed beyond normal growth; re-check in a future Common Crawl release once more pages/links accumulate.

findings.title: No Moz, Bing Webmaster, or DataForSEO data available
findings.description: Tier 0 only (backlinks_auth.py --check). Without a link index, referring-domain count, DA/PA, anchor text distribution, toxic link ratio, link velocity, and geographic relevance cannot be measured — 0 of 7 confidence-weighted scoring factors have a data source, so no numeric Backlink Health Score can be produced.
findings.recommendation: Sign up for the Moz API free tier (https://moz.com/products/api, 2,500 rows/month) and/or verify the domain in Bing Webmaster Tools (free) to unlock real DA/PA and referring-domain data for a future audit.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Enable gzip/brotli for JS+CSS in nginx — ~870 KB saved per uncached visit (15 min)
Add Cache-Control for woff2 and webp, including the LCP hero image (10 min)
Deploy the already-written IndexNow key route so submissions verify (5 min)
Collapse the duplicate Cache-Control header (5 min)

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Add KvK, BTW and postal address to the site-wide footer (30 min)
Add address, geo, openingHours and priceRange to the Organization schema (20 min)
Expand sameAs with LinkedIn, social profiles and the KvK register (15 min)
Shorten 4 over-length titles, add 2 missing og:url, fix entity double-encoding (30 min)

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Build a portfolio or case-study section — the largest single gap
Add bylined author identity and Person schema to the 30 programmatic pages
Build contextual internal links via the Ook interessant blocks to create hierarchy
Add honest outbound citations to authoritative sources
Enrich /contact with NAP, opening hours and ContactPage schema

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Trim the 21 homepage modulepreload hints to the critical path only
Split portal/admin code out of the public marketing bundle
Lazy-load below-fold images and optimise og-image.png
Make sitemap lastmod reflect real content changes
Connect Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools, then re-audit
